mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over the prior 5 trading days signals robust consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where HOUST has increased by at least 0.5% over the prior 5 trading days.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 5.0% signals a tightening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE is below 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low Federal Funds rates (FEDFUNDS < 2.5%) and rising CPI inflation (CPIAUCSL increase > 0.2% in the prior month) signals a favorable economic environment for equities, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where both FEDFUNDS < 2.5% and CPIAUCSL has increased by more than 0.2% in the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of low inflation (CPIAUCSL annual growth < 2.0%), a rise in industrial production (INDPRO > 110.0) signals strengthening economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL annual growth is below 2.0% and INDPRO rises above 110.0.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP (GDPC1) over the prior 60 trading days signals strong economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where GDPC1 has increased by at least 0.5% over the prior 60 trading days.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly employment level (PAYEMS) exceeding 138,000 thousand persons signals robust labor market conditions that drive consumer spending and equity returns, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS exceeds 138,000 thousand persons.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of strong retail sales (RSAFS > 380,000 million dollars) and low Federal Funds rates (FEDFUNDS < 2.5%) signals a favorable economic environment for consumer spending and low borrowing costs, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where RSAFS exceeds 380,000 million dollars and FEDFUNDS is below 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes, a sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO > 110.0) over the prior 60 trading days signals continued economic momentum, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO has increased by at least 0.5% over the prior 60 trading days and the regime is late-cycle expansion.
